paired_design: identical scenario, seed, base-noise and injected-fault realization across B, C3 and C4
latency_policy: For each abrupt sensor-fault scenario, the latency criterion is evaluable only when all five paired C3 and all five paired C4 runs have finite detection_latency_s values. Any missing/nonfinite latency makes that scenario's latency criterion fail; detection-rate preservation is evaluated separately.
